summary: The untracked-directory finding is blocking and has a bounded source-supported repair.

items.title: Untracked directory evidence has no content identity
items.rationale: Regression enumeration must expand untracked directories to leaf files before snapshot creation; otherwise nested content can change while a directory-level null fingerprint remains equal.
items.evidence: listRegressionChangedFiles() currently omits untrackedFiles, so listChangedFilesDetailed() defaults to git status --untracked-files=normal. The helper already supports untrackedFiles=all and enforces the same 2000-entry bound.
